act.AMEND_REGISTRATION.label: Amend registration
act.AMEND_REGISTRATION.meaning: Replace the initial facts. The handler''s case reference remains unchanged.
act.CLEAR_PAYMENT.label: Correct an erroneous payment record
act.CLEAR_PAYMENT.meaning: Remove an erroneously recorded payment date. This is not a refund or reversal of an actual transfer. Earlier history remains.
act.CLOSE.label: Close the case
act.CLOSE.meaning: Close the case. Closing does not mean that payment was made.
act.CORRECT.label: Correct case facts
act.CORRECT.meaning: Correct recorded details on a case with a decision, payment or closed status. All changes are recorded together. Clearing a payment date does not refund money.
act.DECIDE.label: Record payment decision
act.DECIDE.meaning: Record or replace the decided amount and currency. This does not send money.
act.ERASE.label: Erase case payload
act.ERASE.meaning: Permanently remove business payload from the live database. WAL, backups and copies elsewhere are not erased.
act.OPEN.label: Open a case
act.OPEN.meaning: Register the incident, claimant, insurer and amount claimed.
act.RECORD_PAYMENT.label: Record actual payment
act.RECORD_PAYMENT.meaning: Record the date the full decided amount was actually paid. This does not execute or verify a transfer.
act.REINSTATE.label: Reinstate case record
act.REINSTATE.meaning: Restore ordinary case work on a voided record.
act.REOPEN.label: Reopen the case
act.REOPEN.meaning: Reopen the case, preserving its details and history.
act.VOID.label: Void case record
act.VOID.meaning: Block business acts while retaining the case and its history.
act.WITHDRAW_DECISION.label: Withdraw payment decision
act.WITHDRAW_DECISION.meaning: Clear the unpaid decision while preserving its history.
diagnostic.CASE_AMENDMENT_REQUIRES_UNDEC: “Amend registration” requires an undecided case. Use “Correct case facts” to correct recorded registration while keeping its decision.
diagnostic.CASE_CLOSED: This action cannot change a closed case. Use “Correct case facts” for factual corrections while keeping its status, or “Reopen the case” when you intend to resume ordinary case work.
diagnostic.CASE_DECISION_ALREADY_PAID: “Record payment decision” and “Withdraw payment decision” cannot change a paid decision. Use “Correct case facts” for a factual correction, with explicit payment reaffirmation or clearing when replacing a paid decision.
diagnostic.CASE_PAYMENT_NOT_RECORDED: There is no payment record to clear.
diagnostic.CASE_REVISION_CONFLICT: Read the current case before making a changed request.
diagnostic.CASE_ZERO_DECISION_CANNOT_BE_: A zero decision is not a payment.
diagnostic.COMMAND_EXPECTED_REVISION_RAN: Use an integer revision from 0 through 9007199254740991.
diagnostic.CORRECTION_EXISTING_VALUE_REQ: A correction can only replace or clear a value already recorded on this case.
diagnostic.CORRECTION_NO_CHANGES: Choose at least one factual correction that changes the current case.
diagnostic.CORRECTION_PAYMENT_ACKNOWLEDG: Replacing a paid decision requires explicit payment reaffirmation or clearing the payment record.
diagnostic.CORRECTION_PAYMENT_CLEAR_REQU: Clearing a paid decision requires clearing the payment record.
diagnostic.HUMAN_PRINCIPAL_REQUIRED: This role requires a human principal.
diagnostic.INPUT_CALENDAR_DATE_REQUIRED: Use one valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
diagnostic.INPUT_CASE_REFERENCE_FORMAT: Use 1 to 80 printable non-space ASCII characters.
diagnostic.INPUT_COUNTRY_FORMAT: Use two uppercase ASCII letters for the country code.
diagnostic.INPUT_CURRENCY_FORMAT: Use three uppercase ASCII letters (A–Z) for the currency identifier.
diagnostic.INPUT_DATE_ORDER: The dates are in an invalid chronological order.
diagnostic.INPUT_DECIMAL_FORMAT: Use non-negative decimal text: up to {maximumIntegerDigits} integer digits and {maximumFractionalDigits} fractional digits; no sign, exponent or redundant leading zeros: 0.10 is valid; 00.10 is invalid.
diagnostic.INPUT_FUTURE_DATE: A future date cannot record an event that has already occurred.
diagnostic.INPUT_PRINCIPAL_FORMAT: Use a canonical HTTPS issuer and a valid subject for the principal kind.
diagnostic.INPUT_SURROUNDING_WHITESPACE: Leading or trailing whitespace is not accepted.
diagnostic.INPUT_TEXT_TOO_LONG: The value must not exceed {maximumCharacters} Unicode characters.
diagnostic.LAST_OWNER: At least one enabled human owner is required.
diagnostic.LEDGER_SEQUENCE_EXHAUSTED: The ledger has reached its final sequence.
diagnostic.OPERATION_CONTENT_CONFLICT: This operation ID belongs to different act content. Do not reuse it.
diagnostic.OPERATION_RESOLVED: This operation was resolved as not accepted. Read the current state and prepare a new operation with a new ID.
diagnostic.QUERY_CURSOR_INVALID: Use one pagination cursor returned by ClaimCore.
diagnostic.REVISION_EXHAUSTED: The case has reached its final revision.
diagnostic.TEXT_FORMATTING_CHARACTER: Formatting characters are not accepted in a new assertion.
fault.CORE_INTERNAL_ERROR: An internal error occurred. Stop and investigate.
fault.CORE_OPERATION_CONTENT_CONFLICT: Stored operation content is inconsistent. Stop and investigate.
fault.CORE_SCHEMA_MISMATCH: The schema differs from this build. Preserve this installation and use its matching build.
fault.CORE_STORE_INTEGRITY_ERROR: Stored data failed verification. Stop and run verify.
field.caseReference.label: Handler''s case reference
field.caseReference.meaning: Reference assigned by the claims handler operating this register, not an insurer reference. Unique and immutable within one installation; printable non-space ASCII with case-insensitive identity and authored spelling retained.
field.claimantName.label: Claimant name
field.claimantName.meaning: Name of the person or company making the claim.
field.claimedAmount.label: Amount claimed
field.claimedCurrency.label: Currency of claimed amount
field.claimedCurrency.meaning: Currency in which the amount is claimed.
field.incidentCountry.label: Country of incident (ISO alpha-2 code)
field.incidentCountry.meaning: Two uppercase ASCII letters identifying the incident country; ISO alpha-2 syntax only, without membership validation. ZZ means unknown or international.
field.incidentDate.label: Incident date
field.incidentDate.meaning: Date on which the incident occurred.
field.incidentNotificationDate.label: Incident notification date (FNOL)
field.incidentNotificationDate.meaning: Date when this claims handler was first notified of the incident by anyone, not necessarily the claimant. Not the date another insurer or organisation was notified.
field.insurerName.label: Responsible insurer
field.insurerName.meaning: Insurer recorded by the claims handler as responsible for this claim.
field.payableAmount.label: Amount to be paid
field.payableAmount.meaning: Amount the handler decided should be paid. Not recorded until decided; may differ from the claimed amount.
field.payableCurrency.label: Currency of amount to be paid
field.payableCurrency.meaning: Currency of the amount to be paid. Not recorded until decided; may differ from the claimed currency.
field.paymentDate.label: Payment date
field.paymentDate.meaning: Date when the full decided amount was paid, as recorded by the handler. Leave unrecorded if unpaid or unknown. Recording payment does not make or verify a bank transfer.
field.paymentDecisionDate.label: Payment decision date
field.paymentDecisionDate.meaning: Date when this claims handler decided the amount to be paid. Not recorded until a decision is made.
field.status.label: Case status
field.status.meaning: Whether the case is open or closed. Closing a case does not mean that payment was made.
group.decision.label: Payment decision
group.decision.meaning: Keep the current payment decision, replace its date, amount and currency together, or clear the decision.
group.payment.label: Payment record
group.payment.meaning: Keep the current payment date, replace it, or clear the recorded date. Clearing the date does not refund money.
group.registration.label: Registration
group.registration.meaning: Keep the current registration details or replace all seven details together.
host.CONTRACT_MISMATCH: The client contract differs. Reload or use a matching client.
host.INPUT_INVALID: The input does not satisfy the endpoint contract.
host.INTERNAL: The request could not be completed.
host.RESPONSE_FAILED: The completed response could not be delivered.
notice.cancelled: This request was cancelled. Earlier attempts are not settled by this cancellation.
notice.definitionMismatch: The installed Web contract does not match these browser assets. Reload after publishing matching assets.
notice.fileUnreadable: The selected file could not be read.
notice.invalidHttp: The local service returned an invalid HTTP {status} response.
notice.invalidInput: Complete this input using the required format.
notice.missingCsrf: Authenticated session did not include an antiforgery token.
notice.notAccepted: NOT_ACCEPTED: this operation ID will never be accepted for the current actor. If you submitted it as another actor, sign in as that actor to check its outcome. Read current state before preparing a new operation.
notice.outcomeUnknown: The operation outcome is unknown. Retry the exact same operation.
notice.unreachable: The local service could not be reached.
act.REGISTER.label: Register actor
act.REGISTER.meaning: Register a principal without granting case or administration capabilities.
act.GRANT.label: Grant role
act.GRANT.meaning: Grant a role at installation or case scope.
act.REVOKE.label: Revoke role
act.REVOKE.meaning: Revoke a role at installation or case scope. The final enabled human owner remains protected.
act.ENABLE.label: Enable actor
act.DISABLE.label: Disable actor
act.DISABLE.meaning: Disable a registered actor. The final enabled human owner remains protected.
input.cursor.label: Cursor
input.limit.label: Page size
input.reason.label: Stewardship reason
input.reason.meaning: Why the case record should be voided or reinstated.
label.read.case.get.label: Read a case
label.read.case.get.meaning: Read the current accepted case view and available acts.
label.read.case.list.label: List cases
label.read.case.list.meaning: Read one page of cases visible to the actor.
label.read.case.history.label: Read case history
label.read.case.history.meaning: Read accepted history for one case, within current disclosure permissions.
label.read.operation.observe.label: Observe an operation
label.read.operation.observe.meaning: Read an accepted operation receipt when it is visible to the actor.
label.read.operation.resolve.label: Resolve an operation
label.read.operation.resolve.meaning: Read the author’s receipt or durably prevent the operation from being accepted.
label.read.authority.list.label: List actors
label.read.authority.list.meaning: Read registered actors and available authority acts.
label.read.authority.grants.label: Read actor grants
label.read.authority.grants.meaning: Read one page of grants for the selected actor.
label.read.context.label: Read context
label.read.context.meaning: Read the authenticated actor’s capabilities and available resources.
input.operationId.meaning: An ID for this operation. Reuse it only when retrying the same request.
input.expectedRevision.meaning: The case revision on which this request is based.
input.kind.meaning: Whether the target principal is a person or a service.
input.issuer.meaning: The exact HTTPS issuer of the target principal.
input.subject.meaning: The immutable subject or client ID of the target principal.
input.role.meaning: The capability role to grant or revoke.
input.scope.meaning: Whether the role applies to the installation or one case.
input.actorId.meaning: The registered actor whose grants are being read.
input.cursor.meaning: Continue the same query from the opaque cursor returned by the service.
input.limit.meaning: The maximum number of rows to return on this page.
input.full.meaning: Include accepted snapshots when full history is visible to the actor.
input.actorId.label: Actor ID
input.full.label: Full history
